messages:
Jordan L.: Anyone have capacity to borrow 4 A100s overnight for a 3h streaming benchmark? target window 01:00-04:00 UTC. Will hammer the streaming runtime with ~2k concurrent reqs.
Priya R.: Are these dedicated or preemptible? We might need reserved; spot could evict. What's the model + sequence length?
Jordan L.: preemptible ok as long as we have a fallback. model: redwood/rtr-large, seq_len=2048. Need KV cache warm start to reproduce tail-latency.
Mika S.: We have 6 A100s in us-west2-demo-standby pool but billing shows a soft-hold flagged earlier. @infra-bot can you check quota + billing hold status?
infra-bot: Automatic check: region=us-west2, pool=demo-standby. Available GPUs: 6 A100. Tenant quota remaining: 500 GPU-hours this cycle. Billing status: SOFT_HOLD on pool 'demo-standby' due to unpaid invoice #INV-4891.
Sam T.: If invoice is the blocker, finance can clear quickly. @finance-bot can you approve a one-off to lift the hold for a short run?
finance-bot: Invoice INV-4891 flagged for review. Can approve a temporary lift for up to 12 hours if infra confirms estimated usage <= 12 GPU-hours and user tags include 'bench-rl'. Please confirm.
Jordan L.: Estimate = 12 GPU-hours (4 GPUs * 3h). Plan tag: bench-rl/nightly/1719991222. Will tear down right after run.
Priya R.: Also suggest a fallback plan: configure the test to auto-fallback to h100-sim variant if we see evictions (latency will differ but keeps the test executing).
Mika S.: Quick note — we can reserve 4 from demo-standby if finance ok. Here's a terraform snippet to claim the pool (I'll turn into a PR once infra gives green):
``` 
resource "redwood_gpu_allocation" "bench_night" {
  region = "us-west2"
  sku = "A100"
  count = 4
  duration_hours = 3
  tags = ["bench-rl","owner:jordan"]
}
```
infra-bot: Preflight pass: no conflicting allocations during 01:00-04:00 UTC. Quota transiently OK. Billing hold requires manual lift — waiting on finance approval to create reservation.
Sam T.: Finance confirmed they'll approve one-off. @Mika please trigger the reservation and assign ownership to Jordan. :thumbsup:
Mika S.: On it. I'll create the PR with the snippet and trigger the provisional reservation after finance OK. Jordan — do you need a KV cache snapshot uploaded ahead of time?
Jordan L.: Yes please — I'll upload snapshot to s3://bench-rl/kvcache/1719991222 before 00:45 UTC.
infra-bot: Reservation created: res-82219 (4 A100s, us-west2, 01:00-04:00 UTC). Teardown reminder scheduled for 04:05 UTC.
Sam T.: Adding monitoring hooks — enable per-token latency tracing and cost tags. Mika, please add a budget alert if spend > $2k for the run.
Mika S.: Budget alert rule added and linked to reservation res-82219. PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pull/3245 — please review for LGTM.
Jordan L.: LGTM on the PR from my side, smoke tests pass locally. Thanks everyone — I'll post final tail-latency numbers after the run and close the reservation. :raised_hands:
thread_text_summary: Quick ask to borrow 4 A100s overnight for a 3h benchmarking run; infra and finance coordinate to lift a soft billing hold, reservation created (res-82219), terraform snippet and PR linked, KV cache snapshot and monitoring hooks arranged.
